Morning ritual

Day Routine

Start your day with a simple 3-step routine.

☀️1. Cleanse

Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and pat dry.

🥑2. Moisturise

A thin layer of Avocado Glow Cream for soft, comfortable skin.

🧴3. Protect

Finish with sunscreen every morning, especially with kojic acid in your routine.

Evening ritual

Night Routine

Wind down with a simple evening routine.

🌙1. Cleanse

Wash away sunscreen and the day with a gentle cleanser.

✨2. Treat

A pea-sized amount of Glutathione Cream on face and neck.

😴3. Seal

Finish with an Avocado Night Cream as your last step.

Questions, answered

Can I pay Cash on Delivery?

Yes. Choose Cash on Delivery when you order on WhatsApp, or ask for a secure online payment link if you prefer to pay first.

How do I order?

Tap Buy Now on any cream. WhatsApp opens with your order already written. Add your name, address and pincode, send it, and we confirm your order on WhatsApp.

How long does delivery take?

Shipping is free on every order, and most orders arrive in 3 to 7 days anywhere in India. You get a tracking number when your parcel is dispatched.

Which cream should I choose?

Dry skin: the Avocado Night Cream. Most skin types: the Avocado Korean Night Cream. Dull skin: the Glutathione Cream. A complete glass-skin step: the Glass Glow Cream. Want the simplest formula: Avocado Glow Cream 15g. Not sure? The skin quiz takes under a minute.

Will it change my skin colour?

No. Our creams are cosmetics for softer, smoother, brighter-looking skin. They do not change your natural skin tone, and we will never claim they do.

Can I return a cream?

Yes. Unopened, sealed jars can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Damaged, wrong or expired items are replaced or refunded.
